mapper.select: SELECT f.fileName, f.fileSize, DATE_FORMAT(f.fileUploadDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS fileUploadDate FROM userFileList f INNER JOIN webNoteUser u ON u.id = f.Id WHERE u.username = #{username} ORDER BY f.fileUploadDate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO userFileList (Id, fileName, fileSaveName, fileDir, fileSize, fileUploadDate) VALUES (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSaveName}, #{fileDir}, #{fileSize}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
